messages.subject: get.real d.beta.session issue
parts:
Hello!

I've got a model D~session+COV+session*COV that I'm trying to plot with my rsfDF resolution. I've tried the get.real function, with type = "dens" and the new data as the data frame that made up my rsfDF. I keep getting prompted to include d.beta.session, even when I provide it. What am I doing wrong?

messages.author: 58a62321f08f30f8
messages.subject: Re: [oscr] get.real d.beta.session issue
parts:
Hi Asia,

If you add a column called session with the value of 1. Something like `session = factor(1)`. You are fitting a multi-session model, so when predicting the function wants to know which session to predict for. 

Chris
